svg.text: Does a Geneformer T-cell perturbation screen transfer from lung to colon?
Balanced-donor design, Geneformer-V2-316M, re-run unchanged on Pelka 2021 colorectal cancer (E2)
Tumour vs normal T cells, same donor
fresh fold models, same recipe, no LUAD weights reused
deletion shift toward normal (median over donors)
same direction as lung; 78% of bootstraps stable vs a 95% bar
The lung gene pattern does not replicate
unlabelled cluster · kept: CD247, LCK · lost: CD27, CD3G, CD8A, ICOS, LAT
3 of 10 lung hits keep their sign
Pre-registered readings · donor cross-fitting · study, chemistry and annotation also differ between cohorts, so tissue is not the only explanation
